preconditions.description: The input x must be a string.

postconditions.description: The length of the output string must be equal to the length of the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == x[i] for i in range(len(x)) if i == 0 or i == len(x) - 1)
postconditions.description: The first and last characters of the output string must be the same as the first and last characters of the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == x[len(x) - 1 - i] for i in range(1, len(x) // 2))
postconditions.description: The internal characters of the output string must be the reverse of the internal characters of the input string.
